visual_identity.core_identity: A huge serpentine reptile with many pairs of short powerful legs, a horned predatory head,..
visual_identity.silhouette: Very long snake-like torso wrapped in coils, numerous paired legs along the sides, horned head raised from the coil.
visual_identity.head_features: Long reptilian head with strong jaws, backward horns or spines, alert eyes, no wings.
visual_identity.body_shape: Serpentine segmented torso with many pairs of short legs spaced along its length and a tapering tail.
visual_identity.surface: Large simple scales or ridge plates with minimal texture.
must_avoid: most visible torso segments lacking paired legs
visual_identity.limb_structure: Repeated paired short reptilian legs continue along much of the long serpentine torso; multiple distinct left/right leg pairs must remain visible in sequence. The legs stay small relative to body length; no wings, humanoid arms, insect head, four-limbed dragon body, or legless snake body.
visual_identity.shape_lock: Draw one very long serpentine reptile whose torso visibly carries repeated paired short legs along most of its visible length, with multiple leg pairs clearly readable in sequence, ending in a tapering tail. Raise one horned reptilian head from the coils. Keep the silhouette snake-long and many-legged, never dragon-shaped, four-legged, or legless.

accuracy_checks: multiple paired legs remain visibly repeated along the long torso

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.

description: A huge serpentine reptile with many pairs of short powerful legs, a horned predatory head,.. Serpentine segmented torso with many pairs of short legs spaced along its length and a tapering tail. Large simple scales or ridge plates with minimal texture.

scene_identity.size_impression: Huge, extremely long serpentine reptile whose scale comes from body length and repeated short legs rather than dragon bulk.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Long body coils or braces against terrain while many paired short legs visibly contact support along the torso.

known_failure_modes.symptom: body becomes a four-limbed dragon or gains wings
known_failure_modes.correction: remove wings and dragon torso proportions; restore snake-long body with repeated paired short legs

known_failure_modes.symptom: many-legged body collapses into a smooth snake or only a few legs
known_failure_modes.correction: restore repeated paired legs along much of the serpentine torso
